title: Non-interventional observational study on the effectiveness and safety of Ryzneuta® in patients undergoing myelosuppressive chemotherapy in routine clinical practice
summary: This study aims to collect information on how Ryzneuta® is used in everyday medical care. Ryzneuta® is used in adults receiving chemotherapy. Chemotherapy can reduce the number of certain white blood cells that are important for fighting infections. Ryzneuta® helps shorten the time during which the number of these white blood cells is low and reduces the risk of developing fever associated with this condition. Ryzneuta® is prescribed solely as part of the treating physician’s routine clinical decision-making, and participation in the study has no influence on the selection, initiation, administration, or monitoring of treatment.

interventions.name: The study includes adult patients with a non-myeloid malignancy who are undergoing myelosuppressive chemotherapy as part of routine clinical practice, and for whom the decision to use Ryzneuta® was made—independently of study participation—as part of routine clinical care either before or during the

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Presence of a non-myeloid malignant disease.
- Administration of myelosuppressive chemotherapy as part of routine clinical practice.
- The decision to use Ryzneuta® was made independently of study participation, as part of routine clinical practice, either before or during the myelosuppressive chemotherapy.
- At least two cycles of chemotherapy are planned or expected as part of routine clinical care; it should be possible to document at least one of these cycles involving the use of Ryzneuta® within the scope of routine care.
- The patient has been informed about the study and has signed the written informed consent form.
Exclusion criteria:
- Presence of chronic myeloid leukemia (CML) or myelodysplastic syndrome (MDS).
- Known hypersensitivity to efbemalenograstim alfa, G-CSF, or any other component of the medicinal product.
- Pregnancy or breastfeeding.
- Presence of severe chronic neutropenia, or congenital, idiopathic, or cyclic neutropenia.
- Concurrent prophylactic use of another G-CSF in addition to Ryzneuta® within the same documented chemotherapy cycle, if this would significantly compromise the assessment of the study endpoints.
- Participation in another clinical trial, if such participation could significantly influence the assessment of the endpoints of the present study.
